answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to one attested device: a hardware key signs a live challenge, and the registry allows only one identity per device, like one tree per plot in an orchard. A vault stores each device's public key so anyone can verify it, and an attacker who wants a thousand fake agents must forge a thousand real devices, each bought, keyed and kept alive. Clones without hardware are never admitted, so the attack scales only with money spent on real machines, not with free copies.
